platforms.name: Amazon KDP
platforms.model: ebook and print retail, not a private PDF shop
platforms.formats: Kindle ebook and paperback. A raw archive PDF is not a Kindle listing.
platforms.australia: KDP publishes to Amazon stores including Amazon.com.au. Account tax interview was not done.
platforms.fees: Ebook royalty 35%, or 70% in stated territories minus delivery. From 7 July 2026 the 70% band on Amazon.com is USD 2.99–12.99. Print up to 60% minus printing, from the KDP earn page. Delivery example on Amazon.com.au was listed as AUD 0.15 per MB on the KDP pricing help.
platforms.exclusivity: Do not enrol any title in KDP Select. The same text is already public.
platforms.delivers_file: Retailer delivery, not the archive PDF.
platforms.status: BLOCKED — no account, and no verified complete exclusive edition
platforms.next_action: Do not submit. Public copies would conflict with KDP Select, and the three shop titles are not finished private editions.

platforms.name: Draft2Digital
platforms.fees: About 10% of retail as commission, from the FAQ. One-time activation USD 20 for new publishing accounts. Annual USD 12 maintenance if the account earns under USD 100 a year and has titles in distribution. Author share on several stores was listed as about 60% of list on a Draft2Digital royalty article dated around December 2025; that article's Amazon band still said USD 2.99–9.99, which is older than KDP's July 2026 band. Do not treat the article as the current Amazon rate.
platforms.delivers_file: Retail and library delivery after approval.
platforms.status: BLOCKED — no account. Not the first channel.
platforms.next_action: Use only after one direct download shop works, and only for a complete non-exclusive EPUB.

platforms.fees: Page says earn up to 70% and no exclusivity. The exact price bands were not on the page retrieved.
platforms.payout: A Kobo help answer says payment in the author's currency once a month after more than USD 50, otherwise twice a year.
platforms.status: BLOCKED — no account. Royalty bands not fully verified.
